name: Hesperian-Armillary
description: The crust never rests here. Rivers of incandescent basalt vein the lowlands, ash climbs from vents along every fault, and beyond an ancient meteor crater the sky stays the color of a bruise.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.

The terrain around the starship crash site (warship) is scarred for kilometers, and the wreck's black box still loops two seconds of static on an obsolete band. Insurance investigators consider it a haunted assignment.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
